# Android codegen for $"..." translatable strings: i18n Kotlin runtime wiring.
# Verifies that the android platform injects I18n.kt and I18n.init(this) when
# the source package uses i18n intrinsics.

sngl compile --platform=android --lang=kotlin --opt=main=true --out=out app.sngl

# Generated module contains I18n.kt at the expected path.
exists out/app/src/main/kotlin/us/duckfam/git/jonathan/sngl/i18n/I18n.kt

# Generated module contains the main Kotlin source.
exists out/app/src/main/java/test/sngl/app/MainScreen.kt

# MainScreen.kt imports the I18n runtime.
grep 'import us.duckfam.git.jonathan.sngl.i18n.I18n' out/app/src/main/java/test/sngl/app/MainScreen.kt

# MainScreen.kt calls I18n.getTranslator() for the translatable string.
grep 'I18n\.getTranslator\(\)' out/app/src/main/java/test/sngl/app/MainScreen.kt

# MainActivity.kt imports I18n and calls I18n.init(this) in onCreate.
grep 'import us.duckfam.git.jonathan.sngl.i18n.I18n' out/app/src/main/java/test/sngl/app/MainActivity.kt
grep 'I18n\.init\(this\)' out/app/src/main/java/test/sngl/app/MainActivity.kt

# Manifest fixture: when i18n.manifest.json is present in the project root,
# it is copied to app/src/main/assets/i18n.manifest.json.
sngl compile --platform=android --lang=kotlin --opt=main=true --out=out2 app_with_manifest.sngl
exists out2/app/src/main/assets/i18n.manifest.json

-- app.sngl --
output { kotlin { android } }

component main {
    var count int = 1
    var label = $"You have {count, plural, one{# item} other{# items}}"
    text(value=label)
    button(text="Add", @click {
        count = count + 1
        label = $"You have {count, plural, one{# item} other{# items}}"
    })
}

-- app_with_manifest.sngl --
output { kotlin { android } }

component main {
    var msg = $"Hello"
    text(value=msg)
}

-- i18n.manifest.json --
{"Hello":{"en":"Hello","fr":"Bonjour"}}
